svg.text: A001379 on a rotating 3D Hilbert sphere
194 Monster degrees binned into 46×20×9 cells of their (2,3,5)-adic valuations; the 12 higher-dimensional primes set each point’s shell & colour
• position on the sphere = direction set by the (2,3,5)-adic cell • shell radius = total weight of the 12 higher primes
• hue = 9-bit pattern of the single-power primes (17..71) • brightness/size = 7- and 11-adic power • depth = fade + shrink • hover a point for its exact factorisation
46×20×9 = 9870 cells (122 occupied); split proven lossless in RequestProject/A001379Hilbert.lean — one full turn every 26s
